answer: If you ask the clockmaker how he knows a stranger is no clockmaker at all, he opens his escapement book and points at the entries. Cordwainer last record with cordwainers attestation: nine-year record, 3,000 pairs lasted, leather accounts, annual inspection. Present a copied pulse and the movement is refused, the applicant forfeits a bond worth twice the piece and the kernel is struck from the register, while the trellis is kept on file and produced when the guild next sits.
